name: 3x3-xo
description: Tic-Tac-Toe vs an unbeatable minimax AI - frontend, backend and model-service, all Next.js + TypeScript

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix model-service install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n model,backend,frontend -c magenta,blue,green "npm --prefix model-service run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix model-service test && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix model-service run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix model-service run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix model-service run build && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
